transcript: very important musical theater PSA my favorite musical from last season currently has a Kickstarter going to raise funds for a cast album this is Three Houses by Dave Malloy which played off-Broadway in the spring and it was just a brilliant piece of musical storytelling that absolutely shattered me emotionally as I record this they're about two thirds of the way to their fundraising goal so they are in pretty good shape but I still wanted to post about it to get the word out because it's just very important to me that this fundraiser meets its goal there are also some rewards that come with different tiers of donation I don't usually do stuff like this I don't really know what the best way to like link to this Kickstarter is but I can't imagine it's very difficult to find if you Google “Three Houses Kickstarter” it's also on some of the theater news sites but yeah if you're a big fan of cool creative musical theater like I am I definitely recommend chipping in to make this happen thank you
classificationReason: Creator is promoting a Kickstarter for a cast album of 'Three Houses' which is not on the provided list of productions. This is commentary about fundraising, not a review of a live performance.
